checklist.requirement: Use the complete12-file public v0.8.0 package from the supplied ZIP in a separate import root. Preserve bytes; no current KA2/RP5 module substitution, monkeypatch, eager-state helper or float-EMA rewrite. Record __file__ and content hashes of every loaded particlegan module.

Create a fresh comparator process with the extracted public package before any import of particlegan or benchmark modules. Avoid importing RP5 public_worker directly: it prepends its active ROOT and constructs an RP5-only recipe/trainer. Reuse its frozen fixture logic in a separately declared host; imported-source receipt must prove public package resolution. No pip install is needed.

Use the same /tmp/pr38-default-env runtime, Torch2.13.0+cu126 / CUDA12.6 and assigned A6000 execution class as RP5. Preserve deterministic algorithms, TF32 disabled, cuDNN benchmark disabled, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 and thread counts1. Record actual runtime/import paths before the authorized run. Historical Torch2.14/cu130 scores are contextual, not this matched-runtime result.

Construct released factories normally with optimizer_options={foreach:False,fused:False}; leave capturable at its released/native defaultFalse. Ordinary state is lazy. Permit native scalar step tensors on CPU; moments and model/gradient tensors remain on the parameter device. Never prepopulate or relocate state, and do not copy RP5 all-tensors-on-CUDA assertion.

Released GANTrainer lacks serial_backward keyword. Preserve package bytes and wrap each entire public trainer.step call in torch.autograd.set_multithreading_enabled(False) in the declared host. This encompasses penalty autograd.grad(create_graph=True) and loss.backward. Restore caller context through the context manager, including exceptions. Label execution serial explicitly; it is not an unqualified reproduction of an earlier default-threading run. Store execution mode beside schema3 trainer checkpoints and validate before resume; do not inject fields into released state_dict.

Separate learner_total_steps from evaluator_updates in the declaration. get_recipe() literally resolves7000; get_recipe(total_steps=N) is an explicit finite-horizon benchmark override. Suggested matched-window reference uses N equal to the assigned protocol length and label public v0.8.0 K3P with benchmark horizon N. Do not call this literal default configuration. Do not pass None to released K3P, extend/restart a stopped7000-step trainer, change N after a shift, or turn .1N/.2N into360/720. RP5 receivesNone and its independent fixed initialization unchanged.

For the public recovery ring only:20000 particles,z_dim2,batch2048,G/D width96 with3 hidden layers and critic Fourier3,2D output,seed0. Construct G on CPU then CUDA,D on CPU then CUDA,then let the released trainer construct/move prior, matching archived public_worker. Real stream is separate device Generator seeded0; use eight means at radius3 and sigma.07; reuse the D real batch for G. Target changes are evaluator-owned and applied after the declared update.

Before training, compare G,D,prior,EMA_G,EMA_prior and CPU/CUDA/private/data RNG/means hashes with supplied RP5 initial receipt using its frozen digest convention. Compare these fixture components, not whole trainer or optimizer hashes: public K3P differs intentionally in schema/controller/lazy optimizer state. Fail source/initial matching rather than manufacturing a new fixture.

For the public recovery ring only: every10 updates,4096 live samples with isolated device Generator seed9, frozen diversity helper and actual released output_noise_std at completed_steps. All8 modes and HQ>=.90; EMA diagnostic. Never substitute legacy mode_hold.PASS_MODES=7 or its training runner. Preserve target changes, all observations, arrival delay, every later failure and final suffix separately; no81/81 deadline gate.

The separate broader22 mode_hold task intentionally has its own frozen tiny12-particle/z4/batch128 fixture, gate and stream order. Do not apply the public recovery ring20k/z2/batch2048/all8 overrides to that task. Likewise preserve each image/vector/legacy task card if a separate baseline is assigned. This bundle prepares recovery-ring host references, not a rewritten broader runner.

At declared target changes preserve the released schema3 full trainer checkpoint plus caller data RNG/means, execution mode and source/runtime receipts. Frozen control only samples the preserved model at its completed count; its construction/restore must not advance active data or learner streams. No reload occurs in an uninterrupted qualification run.

Declare resolved recipe, finite horizon and evaluator window, source/import/runtime/fixture identity, execution mode and exact changes before training. Preserve full live/EMA metrics, per-update actual group rates/noise, controller diagnostics, initial/final/checkpoint receipts and failure traces. Report accepted updates and runtime: RP5 evaluates two fields per update, released K3P one; equal update counts do not imply equal compute.
